children: Oscar Health updated 2026 guidance, improving its Medical Loss Ratio target and raising Earnings from Operations to $600–$800 million.
Announced 2026 Investor Day on Sept. 16 to discuss strategy, long-term targets and financial outlook.
Improved full-year 2026 Medical Loss Ratio guidance to 81.0%–82.0% (50 bps improvement).
Raised 2026 Earnings from Operations to $600M–$800M, up $100M from prior range.
Reaffirmed 2026 revenue of $18.7B–$19.0B and SG&A expense ratio of 15.6%–16.1%; webcast available on investor site.
